title: Imp Catcher (historical)
start: Wizards' Tower, on the floor 2 (ascend the beam once), talk to Wizard Mizgog.

items.t: These items listed below can be obtained during the quest:

steps.t: To start, go to the Wizards' Tower South of Draynor Village and talk to Wizard Mizgog on the floor 2.
Kill imps anywhere in RuneScape until all four beads are found, or you could buy all four beads at the Grand Exchange
